class.name: CrimsonWeaponAnimationCombo
class.brief_description: Ordered weapon animation clips with authored joins.
class.description: Stores clip keys and the exit, entry and blend settings between them. Legacy resources can be copied into native drafts through [method from_resource].

method.name: from_resource
method.description: Read a detached combo draft from native storage or a legacy saved resource with the same fields. Returns null for incompatible storage.

method.name: copy
method.description: Copy the combo and its per-transition settings for independent editing.

method.name: set_clips
method.description: Replace the sequence and retain authored settings for matching directed pairs, including the closing pair. A new pair initially blends for 0.08 seconds between the natural end and start.

method.name: get_join_count
method.description: Return the number of active transitions. Two or more clips yield one transition per adjacent pair and an optional closing transition.

method.name: get_join
method.description: Return a detached transition record for the outgoing step index. Missing fields and invalid indexes return their defaults.

method.name: set_join
method.description: Set a transition by outgoing step index. At either endpoint a nonempty marker name takes priority. A time of -1 uses the natural boundary. Blend and time arguments are in seconds. Out-of-range indexes leave the resource unchanged.

method.name: resolve_join
method.description: Resolve the active transition against [param player]. Success returns clip keys, durations, names, times, and the requested blend in seconds. An invalid transition returns an [code]error[/code] string.

method.name: validate
method.description: Check the active transitions and each clip's trim order. Returns the first problem or an empty string for a playable sequence.

members.member: Ordered animation library keys accepted by [method AnimationPlayer.play]. Use [method set_clips] to preserve existing transition settings during order edits.
Per-step authored transitions. The final row closes the loop. Each record contains marker names, optional explicit endpoint times, and blend duration in seconds.
Play the transition from the final clip back to the first. Adjusting this flag retains the saved closing transition.
